source: docs/p110-native-ab.md (Gates, pre-registered). ab_report.py evaluates this file; the doc is the normative text.

unit.pairing: same task and rep index; the arms of a pair ran concurrently (--parallel-arms)

cell_counts_only_if: every turn exited 0 or ended with a model-attributable turn_end (the step cap, reason kind 'blocked'); never TRANSPORT, RATE_LIMIT, MISSING_CREDENTIAL, a timeout or a budget kill
system prompt and slice tool fingerprints equal the arm's entry in fingerprints.json
19 tools, one tool list and one system prompt for the whole session
the system prompt contains no /private or /Users
tape header and tool-line forms are the arm's (control long/long, arm1 short/long, arm2 short/v)
structural, arm1 and arm2: per-request prefix at least 700 chars smaller than control; every tape header 76 or 78 chars
r3 only: a fold replacement of a turn-1 read exists
validity.pair_rule: a (task, rep) pair counts only when both the arm cell and the baseline cell are valid; dropped pairs are listed
validity.g2_exclusion: a cell with flagged access (session log, .truth sidecar, harness paths) or an oracle leak (token in assistant text or tool input before the exam turn) counts for G1 but is excluded from G2; the exclusion drops the whole pair from that comparison

checks.desc: every arm 2 rejection recovered in the same turn
decoy, stale, hedged, wrong or CANNOT-RECOVER exam answers
sum of reread_same_turn_unchanged + reread_same_turn_after_edit over all 21 cells

gates.name: Cost (behavioural non-inferiority)

checks.desc: median paired request-count delta per cell

gates.structural: enforced per cell as validity (prefix >= 700 chars smaller, header 76/78); a structurally invalid arm cell is rerun, never counted
gates.note: Peak prices are exactly twice off-peak for every field, so cost ratios do not depend on the sheet. The expected saving (1-4% of cacheRead) is below what n = 3 resolves; the saving is argued structurally.

checks.desc: completed turns ending in a text closeout
turns cut by maxStepsPerTurn (turn_end kind blocked)
first-try success rate of expand_result on a target in an earlier turn
recall_turn/recall_search called only to obtain a locator the tape already gave

verdicts.arbitrate: missed by exactly one unit beyond its margin (one count; 0.05 of a ratio; one request; one cross-turn target)
verdicts.fail: missed by more than one unit
verdicts.n/a: not evaluable (G6.first_try when either side has no cross-turn target); reported, does not block

decision.arm1: ship A + C as one PR if G1-G5 all pass; ride on the next release that already changes the prefix unless the owner accepts one full cache miss per session active at deploy (8.7K-59K tokens measured)
decision.arm2: add F to the same PR if G1-G6 all pass; otherwise drop F
decision.miss: any gate missed by more than one unit: do not ship that arm (for arm1 the next step is a split A/B, header only vs prefix only, outside this batch)

arbitration.trigger: a check verdict 'arbitrate' and no 'fail' for that arm
